rationale: PWRC and its cross-chain infrastructure are the canonical center of this repository.
The name distinguishes this monorepo from wallet, launchpad, website and other PowerChain repositories.
The monorepo includes token, bridge, API, browser client, docs, SDK, runtime, contracts, programs and release tooling.

alternatives.name: powerchain-core
alternatives.useWhen: This repository becomes the canonical home for all PowerChain core infrastructure beyond PWRC.

alternatives.name: powerchain-protocol
alternatives.useWhen: Application surfaces are split out and this repository becomes protocol/contracts/release focused.
